QueryString: SELECT eventtime,eventname,eventid,recipientaccountid,sourceipaddress,useridentity FROM lab.cloudtrail WHERE from_iso8601_timestamp(eventtime) >= from_iso8601_timestamp(?) AND from_iso8601_timestamp(eventtime) < from_iso8601_timestamp(?) AND recipientaccountid = ? AND eventname = ? AND event_date IN (?,?) ORDER BY eventtime,eventid LIMIT 100000
